entry.title: Η Τουρκία παραδέχεται την παρενόχληση στο αεροσκάφος που μετέφερε τον Δένδια
entry.summary: Turkey indirectly but clearly admitted the harassment of the C-27 transport carrying Defense Minister Nikos Dendias to Cyprus, an incident also involving French and Dutch aircraft. Dendias briefed the EU defense ministers' meeting on it.

entry.title: Λίγο πριν από τις κάλπες το κόμμα από τον Σαμαρά
entry.summary: Reportedly, Antonis Samaras' new party 'is ready' and the former PM is weighing the political landscape before launching it, with 'Greek Citizens' floated as a possible name. Contacts over candidate lists are intensifying.

entry.title: Κυρ. Μητσοτάκης για το «gov.gr»: «Πίσω από κάθε ταλαιπωρία του πολίτη μπορεί να κρύβονται φαινόμενα διαφθοράς»
entry.summary: Marking six years of gov.gr, PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis argued the state's digital reform cut bureaucracy and corruption, noting countries such as Germany now seek Greek expertise. He said that 'behind every inconvenience to the citizen, phenomena of corruption may be hiding.'

entry.title: Μπήκαν υπογραφές σε κρίσιμη συμφωνία Κύπρου – Γαλλίας
entry.summary: A SOFA agreement was signed between France and the Republic of Cyprus institutionalizing the stationing of French forces in the free, southern part of the island. It marks a deepening of Nicosia–Paris defense ties.

entry.title: «Σήμα» Νετανιάχου προς Τραμπ και Ιράν με την εκκένωση της Τύρου
entry.summary: The evacuation order for the city of Tyre in southern Lebanon and the bloody Israeli strike that followed are read as a Netanyahu 'signal' to Trump and Iran. Israel continues operations against targets it links to Hezbollah.

entry.title: Μαρινάκης: Εκλογές το 2027, δεν επιλέγουμε αντίπαλο – Στόχος να υπάρξουν νέες φοροελαφρύνσεις
entry.summary: Government spokesman Pavlos Marinakis reiterated that elections will be held in 2027, rejecting early-poll scenarios, and set new tax cuts as a goal. He also commented on the recent reshuffle and Tsipras' nascent party.

entry.title: Οι άγνωστες μεταβλητές στην αγορά πετρελαίου
entry.summary: The biggest oil-supply shock in decades enters its fourth month, with neither the US nor Iran backing down, yet the market remains surprisingly calm. Key unknowns include how long global stockpiles can last.

entry.title: Ουάσιγκτον: Ειρηνικό μοντέλο ενεργειακής συνεργασίας στην Αν. Μεσόγειο
entry.summary: The East Mediterranean Gas Forum ministerial in Washington, under Greek presidency, reaffirmed an energy-cooperation model for the Eastern Mediterranean grounded in international law and shared interests. The framework moves away from unilateral and aggressive actions.

entry.title: Δίκη για Τέμπη: Αίτημα Κωνσταντοπούλου για έγγραφο επικοινωνίας ΝΣΚ – Κυρανάκη
entry.summary: At the Tempi trial, Zoe Konstantopoulou requested a document of communication between the State Legal Council and former deputy transport minister Kostas Kyranakis. The request concerns the State's declaration of participation.

entry.title: Κυβέρνηση: Το σκεπτικό των σημειακών αλλαγών
entry.summary: The reshuffle decided by Kyriakos Mitsotakis on returning from the US was ultimately limited, with Giorgos Kotsiras moving to Transport and a chain of changes. Marilena Soukouli becomes deputy environment minister, succeeding the late Nikos Tagaras.

entry.title: Διψήφια άνοδος των ελληνικών εξαγωγών το πρώτο τετράμηνο
entry.summary: Greek exports rose by double digits—11.3%—in the first four months of 2026, reaching 17.77 billion euros despite geopolitical turbulence. Food remained a strong card, while exports to the US also grew.

entry.title: Εντός και Εκτός: O Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων και η επίσκεψη Τραμπ
entry.summary: The 'Entos kai Ektos' column raises European states' growing cooperation with Turkey's defense industry, with PASOK defense spokesman Michalis Katrinis pressing minister Nikos Dendias for answers. It cites Safran's cooperation with the maker of Bayraktar drones.

entry.title: Ερευνα: Μόλις 1 στα 10 παιδιά από χαμηλά στρώματα φτάνει στην ανώτατη εκπαίδευση
entry.summary: An IOBE study reveals that just 1 in 10 children from low-income strata reaches higher education, highlighting persistent inequalities. Income gains have not translated into equal opportunities for households.

entry.title: Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 100 οι νεκροί από τον Εμπολα
entry.summary: Ebola deaths surpassed 100 in eastern Congo, less than a month after the outbreak was declared. Attacks on health workers, skepticism and armed conflict are hampering efforts to contain the epidemic.

entry.title: Κυρ. Πιερρακάκης για τα 6 χρόνια «gov.gr»: «Οι Ελληνες πίστεψαν ξανά ότι η χώρα μπορεί να αλλάξει»
entry.summary: Economy minister and Eurogroup president Kyriakos Pierrakakis called gov.gr 'the story of a country that decided to change' at the platform's six-year anniversary event. He recalled the path from the idea's inception to the portal's establishment.

entry.title: Θεωρείο: Το σχέδιο Σαμαρά
entry.summary: In the 'Theoreio' column, the writer decodes the 'Samaras plan,' noting a discreet overture from the former PM toward Nikos Androulakis. He suggests a broader understanding is being sought should New Democracy weaken.

entry.title: Θολό το τοπίο για τις επόμενες κινήσεις του ΣΥΡΙΖΑ
entry.summary: SYRIZA's Central Committee did not decide the party's future should Alexis Tsipras insist on not cooperating with other forces. Socratis Famellos secured a majority but pushed the crucial decisions further down the road.

entry.title: Η νέα εποχή των ελληνικών ναυπηγείων
entry.summary: Greece's shipbuilding industry is attempting a systematic revival, leveraging geopolitical realignments and the West's need to diversify its industrial base. Deals with international giants and defense projects are multiplying.

entry.title: Σοκάρει η ταχύτητα των καρτέλ: Ενα νέο τεχνητό ναρκωτικό κάθε εβδομάδα
entry.summary: The European Drug Report 2026 warns the market is becoming more complex and dangerous, with cartels launching a new synthetic drug almost every week. The report was presented in Brussels by the EUDA.

entry.title: Μεγάλο στοίχημα για το ΠΑΣΟΚ το λεκανοπέδιο
entry.summary: PASOK is crafting a special strategy for the Attica basin, an electorally tough area holding 40% of the electorate. Nikos Androulakis asked for proposals to tackle the capital's 'electoral riddle.'
